defs.def: a system for talking to sb else over long distances, using wires or radio; a machine used for this 电话；电话系统；电话机

ex.s: As it has been many years since I last used one, I should hardly be surprised that there are no longer any public telephones near my house.
ex.t: 距离我上次使用电话亭已经很多年了，所以我几乎不惊讶我家附近已经没有任何公用电话了。

defs.def: the part of the telephone that you hold in your hand and speak into 电话听筒

ex.s: When was the last time you used a telephone box?
ex.t: 你上次使用电话亭是什么时候？

ex.s: My mobile phone was inside, but luckily there was a telephone box across the street.
ex.t: 手机在里面，但幸运的是街对面有一个电话亭。

ex.s: If I ever get trapped outside my house again, my local telephone box will, sadly, no longer be able to connect me with my keys.
ex.t: 如果我再次被困在屋外，我当地的电话亭将悲哀地不能再帮我拿到钥匙了。
•每次双人见面的周进度报告

ex.s: Why did the author use the telephone box in 2006?
■On the same sheet of paper, write or type your name, address, telephone number, and birth date.
ex.t: ■在同一张纸上写下或打印你的姓名、地址、电话号码和出生日期。

ex.s: And it's all supported by an efficient customer service team, available through telephone, email and online chat.
ex.t: Lancom关心你，照顾到你个人的学习类型。

defs.def: to be using the telephone 在打电话；在通电话
to have a telephone in your home or place of work （在家里或工作单位）装有电话机的

ex.s: Then there were the great Western inventions: the steam engine, the telephone and the radio.
ex.t: 还有那些伟大的西方发明：蒸汽机、电话和无线电。

ex.s: A far cry from the bright lights and shiny courts of the National Basketball Association (NBA), it was along this road that Stephen's grandfather built a simple basket by attaching a piece of plastic to a telephone pole.
ex.t: 与NBA（美国职业篮球联赛）明亮的灯光和闪亮的球场相去甚远，正是在这条路上，斯蒂芬的祖父把一块塑料固定在一根电线杆上，做成了一个简易的篮筐。

ex.s: Along this road, Stephen’s grandfather built a simple basket by fixing a piece of plastic to a telephone pole.
ex.t: 沿着这条路，斯蒂芬的祖父把一块塑料固定在一根电线杆上，做成了一个简易的篮筐。

ex.s: After all, how many of us today would rather send a message packed with emojis than make a telephone call?
ex.t: 毕竟，如今我们有多少人宁愿发一条满是表情符号的信息，也不愿打个电话？

ex.s: It is certainly more convenient to take out a mobile and make a call at the touch of a button than to press a series of long numbers on a telephone.
ex.t: 掏出手机按一下按键打电话，肯定比在电话上按一长串数字方便得多。
